chapters.title: Twitter Space Recovery and Show Kickoff
chapters.description: Hosts apologize for a Twitter Spaces startup glitch that made the room appear live before others could join, then thank Scott and the audience. Ishan Anand and Anthony Campolo of Edgio relaunch JavaScript Jam Live as an open mic for JavaScript and web development, introduce the React Miami collaboration, and bring Scott on the air.

chapters.title: React Miami Month and Guest Arrivals
chapters.description: Scott Steinlage of Edgio recasts the series as React Miami Month, promising conference speakers, extra goodies, and the usual JavaScript Jam vibe. He invites beginners and advanced developers to come up with questions. Dev Agrawal introduces himself as a media partner, Dan briefly explains he cannot attend, and Michelle joins as a React Miami organizer.

chapters.title: Miami Jam Game Show Format
chapters.description: Michelle reconnects after microphone trouble and welcomes the media partners with a free hand to experiment. Dev describes Miami Jam, a trivia game show with Anthony and Scott instead of a typical interview panel. Questions on React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and speaker topics will lead into deeper talks, with audience scoring and interaction through 00:08:42.
